faq.q: How much does KRLG Injury Lawyers charge?
faq.a: KRLG Injury Lawyers publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does KRLG Injury Lawyers offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. KRLG Injury Lawyers publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does KRLG Injury Lawyers have offices?
faq.a: KRLG Injury Lawyers publishes two offices, among them Scottsdale. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at KRLG Injury Lawyers?
faq.a: KRLG Injury Lawyers names twelve attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: Are the case results KRLG Injury Lawyers publishes verified?
faq.a: No. KRLG Injury Lawyers publishes eleven case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about KRLG Injury Lawyers?

Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure, discipline and entity registration. json_ld_descriptions: KRLG Injury Lawyers is an Arizona personal injury law firm representing accident and injury victims in Phoenix, Scottsdale, and throughout Maricopa County. The firm handles car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, rideshare (Uber/Lyft) accidents, construction accidents, product liability, and wrongful death claims. With over 100 years of combined experience and more than $250 million recovered for clients, KRLG Injury Lawyers offers free consultations on a contingency fee basis and is available 24/7.

KRLG Injury Lawyers is a personal injury law firm founded in 2023 by co-founders Austin Kurtz and Brian Riley, representing accident and injury victims throughout Phoenix, Scottsdale, and Maricopa County, Arizona. With over 100 years of combined experience, the firm handles car accidents, truck accidents, motorcycle accidents, rideshare (Uber/Lyft) accidents, construction accidents, product liability, and wrongful death cases. KRLG Injury Lawyers has recovered over $250 million for clients and offers free consultations on a contingency fee basis.
